connectionSummary: eBay connection has not started. This loop is design-only. Sandbox-first is required. OAuth is not configured. No tokens are stored. No eBay API calls are allowed. No eBay draft can be created. No eBay publication is allowed. Official eBay documentation validation is required before implementing OAuth, scopes, endpoints or token handling.

allowedInThisLoop: Render read-only eBay connection design section in Admin.
Add tests for connection design, readiness, safety and blocked workflows.
forbiddenInThisLoop: Do not call Luna Portex APIs.
Do not hardcode scopes, auth URLs, token URLs or API endpoints.
integrationBoundaries.officialValidationPolicy: Scopes, endpoints, consent behavior and token handling must be validated against official eBay documentation in a future implementation loop before any real integration code is written.

blockedWorkflows.reason: OAuth must not be implemented in this design-only loop.
Token exchange is not allowed before official documentation validation and a dedicated implementation loop.
Token storage is not allowed in code or fixtures.
